event.title: Anthropic Launches Record IPO, Valued at $1.5 Trillion on Nasdaq
event.canonical_title: Anthropic Launches Record IPO, Valued at $1.5 Trillion on Nasdaq
event.summary: Anthropic has begun trading on the Nasdaq following a record initial public offering (IPO) that raised approximately $81.3 billion. This valuation positions the AI company at around $1.5 trillion, surpassing SpaceX's previous record of $75 billion. Despite concerns about market volatility and public sentiment towards AI, the company's shares surged upon debut.

timeline.title: Widespread Protests Erupt Across Europe Over Living Costs and Wages
timeline.summary: Protests have erupted across Europe, with workers and students taking to the streets in response to rising living costs and demands for better wages and services. The demonstrations, inspired by recent protests in France, have seen significant participation, particularly in Italy, where a strike has disrupted services.

timeline.title: Protests Erupt Over COP31's Inaction on Fossil Fuels
timeline.summary: Activists and civil society groups protested during the COP31 climate talks, criticizing the event for failing to advance discussions on moving away from fossil fuels. The talks, held in Turkey, extended into overtime as delegates struggled to reach consensus on key issues, with fossil fuels notably absent from the draft deal.

event_overview.title: About AI Industry
event_overview.subject: AI Industry
event_overview.summary: The event is Anthropic, PBC's transition from a privately held artificial-intelligence developer to a publicly traded company through the sale and Nasdaq listing of its Class A common stock. The listing made its shares available for public trading under the symbol ANT, while the company retained a public-benefit corporate structure and an unusual multi-class governance system.

facts.label: Listing date and market
facts.value: Anthropic Class A common stock began public trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026, under the ticker ANT.

facts.label: Offering price
facts.value: Nasdaq's listing notice identified an IPO price of $83.00 per Class A share.

facts.label: Issuer and legal form
facts.value: The issuer is Anthropic, PBC, a Delaware public benefit corporation; the company says its purpose is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for humanity's long-term benefit.

facts.label: Company purpose
facts.value: Anthropic describes itself as developing frontier AI systems intended to be reliable, interpretable, and steerable, alongside research and safety techniques for their deployment.

facts.label: Governance
facts.value: The company's filing describes it as a Nasdaq 'controlled company' because its Long-Term Benefit Trust, through Class T common stock, generally can elect a majority of authorized directors; the company also uses multiple classes of stock.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the November 19, 2026 public-market debut, not Anthropic's full corporate history, its subsequent share-price performance, or broader developments across the AI industry.
